question: Within the pinned Mayig feature namespace, what do P041, V041, P110, P112, and local 110/112/041 actually refer to?
result: The Mayig namespace separates all tempting numeric shortcuts. P041 maps to Parpola V141/Wells W112/Mahadevan M034, while Parpola V041 appears under Mayig P301, a small hatched box feature. Current overlap gives only very-low local 112 <-> Mayig P041 pressure and no local 110 confirmation.
